title: A local silent-undo run compares against the PR's base, not main
why: lint/check_silent_undo.py defaults `--upstream origin/main`, so a local run on a PR stacked on another branch compares against main and not the PR's base (lane lint-uses-pinned-tools, coordinator 02:49 CST Nov 8). Not covered by open #1677 (Retire-run cite), #1712 (CI reads the PR body) or #1726 (reason for an unread cite), by their steps' titles.
note: Fix: a local run resolves the PR's base (or the branch's upstream) and compares against it; with none found, it says which base it used. Red case first: a stacked branch whose base differs from main, where today's run reports lines main lacks. Control: a PR based on main is unchanged. Related steps: silent-undo-reads-retire-run, silent-undo-ci-body, retire-excuse-silent-refusal. Queue fix (owner 13:20 CST Nov 7). Slug from the lane. Filed 02:52 CST Nov 8.
